name: opt
description: A checkable option: a small keyline tick and a label, pressed or not (aria-pressed). The composer's "keep out of memory" and the entry memory menu's choices.

form.description: compact: the user-requested compact memory control in the entry memory menu (was .entry-memory-menu > .opt): --t-memory, a 12px tick, start-aligned.

states.active: yes: pressed 1px down, and scaled .97 under the shell's motion
states.loading: n/a: the choice is saved in the background
states.error: n/a: the surrounding view reports it

a11y.keyboard: Tab to it, Space or Enter

changelog.change: Converted from lock.css E6 (.opt, .tick), with its compact form in the entry memory menu.
The compact form's label is its own span, which opt.css styles (min-width, wrapping).
